claims.statement: The planned LangGraph runtime loop orders stages as understand, retrieve semantic, plan, generate SQL, validate with policy, estimate cost with EXPLAIN, approval gate, execute read-only with bounded fix retries, mask PII, chart plus insight, reviewer check, then answer or report or alert.

The architecture is owned as agent equals model plus harness, where the harness comprises the LangGraph workflow, DB tools via MCP, skills, semantic index, checkpointer and memory, RBAC plus PII policy, trace and audit log, guardrails, and eval runner.

The agent package exposes a frozen root skeleton with a registry seam: AGENT_SHELL plus shared state, graph builder, and registry public surface, with sibling plans satisfying RootGraphDeps hooks without editing graph.ts.

Shared tools follow fixed contracts: metadata tools are role-filtered, sample_rows returns at most 5 masked rows, validate_sql has no DB access, explain_query runs EXPLAIN without ANALYZE, run_query enforces read-only plus timeout plus row cap plus RBAC, search_semantic_layer is knowledge-only, render_chart accepts only spec JSON, send_alert is allowlisted with retry and dedup, and at least one tool is a genuine external system.

The read-only invariant requires the agent to use a SELECT-only PostgreSQL role or read-only DuckDB and SQLite open mode, enforced at the connection layer so prompt-only blocking is insufficient and violations zero the affected use case.

The SQL validator allows exactly one SELECT or WITH statement with existing tables and columns and absolutely bans DDL and DML, multi-statement payloads, and dangerous functions such as pg_sleep, COPY, pg_read_file, and ATTACH, which are never offered for cost approval.

Every surviving query gets an EXPLAIN cost estimate, pauses via interrupt when above the row threshold, presents SQL plus estimate plus a cheaper alternative, resumes at the pause point on approve without regenerating SQL, proposes another approach on reject, carries a database statement_timeout, and audit-logs asker, SQL, estimate, approver, and decision.

The system requires at least two reusable skills, each as a directory with name, description, usage triggers, inputs and outputs, steps, constraints, examples, and final check, and no skill may include a script that runs arbitrary commands or connects with a different database account.

Short-term AnalysisState and multi-step task state with todo, doing, done, skipped, and failed persist in a checkpointer with resume, compaction, branching on contribution share, depth and query caps, per-step retry that marks failed and continues, and interrupt-based human review of plans and costly queries.

A separate Reviewer agent with only schema, dictionary, and small check-query access validates question, SQL, results, and conclusions for fan-out, missing filters, wrong metrics, and unsupported claims, returns approve or request_changes with categorized findings, and coordinates at most two revision rounds.

PII masking and RBAC rewriting run before display and before cost estimation, then chart selection and 2 to 4 insights proceed under chart-spec and per-number validators that require every claimed number to trace to a query cell.

Every run records a run ID and trace with user and role, nodes, tool calls with arguments results and timing, all SQL versions including failures, EXPLAIN cost, applied RBAC policy, skill calls, token and cost estimates, errors, and approval decisions, with no unmasked PII, secrets, or connection strings.
The agent equals model plus harness: the model proposes intent, SQL, plans, charts, and prose while the deterministic harness owns validation, execution, policy, state, and audit.

Agent, access-policy, and app code must not import pg, pg-cursor, or mcp-server internals and must reach the database only through the MCP client, while the web UI is additionally restricted to contracts-only imports.

The ValidatedQueryExecutor runs selective describe_table for candidate tables only, structured SqlProposal generation, local sqlGuard plus LocalQuerySafetyGate pre-check with no MCP past failure, explain_query then run_query, and a bounded repair loop capped at MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 with exactly one TIMEOUT simplification that drops ORDER BY, clamps to 50 rows, and re-passes gates.

Shared contracts are frozen additive-only at CONTRACTS_VERSION 1.1.0 with camelCase canonical, where breaking changes require a major bump plus approval from every affected owner; 1.1.0 added optional rowScopeApplied plus additive UC-10 alert schemas (AnomalyAlertResponseSchema.data remains z.unknown()) as the additive precedent.

Frozen tool schemas enforce server-side scope filtering via strict empty list_tables input, per-column sensitive flags, run_query row caps with masked-column plus server-minted rowScopeApplied reporting, and a five-row sample cap.

The harness uses 12 frozen ErrorCodes where only TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED, and INTERNAL_ERROR are retryable and only INVALID_SQL, UNKNOWN_TABLE, and SQL_EXECUTION_ERROR are repairable, routed via dbToolError into transport retry, bounded repair, or immediate hard abort.

SQLAnswer carries intent, nullable sql, tablesUsed, citations, at most 3 attempts, at most 50 preview rows, a seven-value status enum including false_premise, and telemetry with prompt, completion, embedding, cost, and latency fields.

Every trace event carries run, thread, user, role, node, type, timestamp, and duration identity with optional spanId, parentSpanId, and attempt, and trace and audit sinks are written only after shared PII redaction.
Safety is enforced in code through a read-only database role with statement timeout, shared sqlGuard parsing, AccessPolicy rewriting, and PII scanning, independent of prompt compliance.
Skills stay declarative Markdown or YAML contracts with no runnable scripts, database connections, or credentials.

The frozen root builder compiles budgetGuard, understand, retrieve, allowlist router, ucEntry or defaultEntry, statusCheck, and vizSeam plus answer nodes, routing only to registry overlay entries with a per-graph text-to-sql override and throwing at build time when the tracer default route is missing.

Shared AgentState is JSON-only with resultPreview capped at 50 rows and a 1000-row transient buffer outside state, run budgets defaulting to 20 LLM calls, 60000 tokens, and 120000 ms window, plus intent, SQL, status, telemetry, run and thread identity, clarification, and UC-05 plan and answer fields with additive budget and telemetry reducers.

Durable memory is host-injected through createCheckpointer, which pins the langgraph schema, runs setup exactly once, fails fast without falling back to MemorySaver, and rejects the read-only agent_ro connection string.
The agent-side safety gate denies sensitive-column references in any clause and conditionless joins, while policy-restricted error codes map to restricted status and all other failures map to error.
MCP run identity is forked from host-populated RunnableConfig into per-call transport headers rather than tool arguments, and span payloads carry counts and column names only, never cell values.
Focused agent tests pin the root graph seam with injected doubles, the executor core path with canned proposals and stub MCP caller, and the safety-gate matrix without live credentials.
The root budgetGuard seeds one persistent absolute deadline on entry and short-circuits tripped runs directly to answer, so no model or MCP I/O runs after a budget trip.

The text-to-SQL runtime loads the text-to-sql skill contract to propose a serializable intent with one budgeted LLM call, serves definition_lookup from retrieved chunks and unknown-term rejections without executor or MCP, normalizes schema entities to bare table names, and runs the executor on a copied BudgetState writing back only deltas.

The host builds durable checkpoints through createCheckpointer with a connection string only and pinned langgraph schema, failing fast on setup errors and rejecting the read-only agent_ro URL before any network call.

HITL uses fail-closed chat:{userId}:{sessionId} thread ids, same-thread gating, validated clarification payloads with two to four options, and interrupt plus Command resume so approval suspends inside the node and resume on the same thread does not re-run completed nodes.
Per-call MCP identity comes from RunnableConfig.configurable and travels as Authorization plus run, user, and role-scope headers, never from prompt text or tool arguments.
Every trace event gets a random UUID span id, passes shared PII redaction and TraceEventSchema validation, and appends one redacted JSON line per event under traces/<runId>.jsonl.

The agent-side LocalQuerySafetyGate runs after sqlGuard before any MCP call, denying catalog-marked sensitive columns in any clause, denying unconditioned JoinExpr and comma-separated FROM as implicit cross joins, routing large-table scans without a conjunctive orders.purchase_date bound to needs_clarification, and clamping passing non-aggregate queries to LIMIT 200 while aggregates pass through.

Empty results run a single-pass zero-row diagnostic only on attempt 1 when a WHERE filter is present: resolve up to three string-literal predicates, re-describe and sample_rows n=5 per table, run guarded DISTINCT LIMIT 20 probes, retry only on a concrete near-match, otherwise conclude no_data with probe failures recorded as notes.
